events.statement: A deployment dep-5905 of portfolio-service v4.5.0 went live at 2026-05-05T08:56:00Z adding 'new query on trades filtered by account_id + executed_at' with 'no migration included', status live and not rolled back.

Only one deployment exists in the 06:00-10:59 window across all services: dep-5905 (portfolio-service). No order-service deployment appears (report's 'order-service has not been released this week' is consistent).
ledger-db config change cfg-2903 lowered autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor on ledger-db from 0.2 to 0.1 at 2026-05-05T08:00:00Z by dba-team ('More aggressive autovacuum').
ledger-db slow query log shows repeated 'Seq Scan on trades (rows=48211907)' with application_name=portfolio-service, first at 2026-05-05T08:58:38Z (8690ms).
ledger-db slow_queries_per_min was ~1/min through 08:40, then jumped in the 08:50 bucket (avg 28.79, max 139.68) and sustained ~140/min from 09:00 onward.
ledger-db cpu_pct rose from ~30% (through 08:40) to ~96% from the 08:50 bucket onward (e.g. 95.59 at 09:00), max 98.05.
ledger-db connections_active rose from ~61 (through 08:40) to ~190 sustained from 08:50 onward, max 212.35.
order-service latency_p99_ms was ~150ms through the 08:40 bucket, then rose in 08:50 (avg 694, max 5607) and settled ~5200ms from 09:00 onward.
order-service error_rate jumped from ~0.2% (through 08:40 and 08:50) to ~9.4% from the 09:00 bucket onward.
order-service db_pool_in_use rose from ~14 (through 08:40) to ~47 sustained from 09:00 onward, max 51.63.
order-service logs show 284 errors 'canceling statement due to statement timeout (INSERT INTO orders)', first at 2026-05-05T09:00:42Z.
portfolio-service logs show 'holdings P&L query took <n>ms for account <n>' warnings (239 occurrences) first seen 2026-05-05T08:59:39Z (7459ms).
ledger-db disk_used_pct stayed flat ~71% and replication_lag_ms flat ~40ms through the whole window (no storage or replication degradation).
ledger-db and order-service are connected: order-service, portfolio-service, payment-service and settlement-service all call ledger-db (a shared postgres).

Historical incident HIST-111 (2025-05-22) had the same pattern: a new report query without an index caused sequential scans and high DB CPU on ledger-db; root cause bad_deployment. (Lead only, not current evidence.)
